name: person
title: Person
description: The one initials rule for a person's avatar — first and last word, two letters of a single word, else the email — shared by PersonAvatar and every people surface.

meta.whenToUse: Deriving a person's initials outside PersonAvatar (a mention, an export) so they match the avatar.
meta.whenNotToUse: Drawing an avatar — compose PersonAvatar, which applies the rule itself.
